Name: Fish Factory (PIF)
Author: cryomancer199x
Description:
I decided to try another PIF room. This one's pretty basic, it's just a room to put your fish ponds in. It upgrades in size along with your house. It's designed with 4 ponds per room in mind, but you can do as you please. If you're using automate you can probably cram like 9 per room in there. The full size one can hold 24 ponds with the ~aesthetically intended~ layout, more if you place them as you want. Automate can be set to use paths as a connective piece and feed them all back to a chest if you'd like that too, it's cool give it a try.

This adds the new upgradable (upgrades with farmhouse) room, and while you are in the room the following will change graphically:
Fish Ponds will become somewhat higher tech looking
Signs will become monitors, one color for each sign type
Fish Pond shadows will be blanked out
Aquaponics will work too and have their shadows removed while indoors.

Mod also adds 10 doors to the door shop, some from the bathhouse tileset and a few custom variants. There's an indoor (paintings) and outdoor version for each so you should be able to put them mostly anywhere. Walls and floors can be decorated. There's not too much valid wall space for hanging things but there are some spots here and there.

Version 2 adds a requested buildable farm building, but I couldn't QUITE get it to work as you'd imagine. So what you get is like a fake shell building you can place on your farm, and then just place a door of your choice from this mod on it and use as a PIF room from there. Best way I could figure how to do it, let me know if you encounter issues with it. Graphics adapted from Mother 3.

As always, thanks very much to the modding discord for all the help (especially fireredlily and Esca). This one had me going nuts for awhile a few times.

There are a few issues that tend to come up that I can't quite track down, so if you are having problems I'd suggest trying to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21233]Anything Anywhere[/url] and or CBJ Cheats (instant buildings) to accomplish whatever step you are stuck on. Let me know if you can nail down a cause and I'll check it out, thanks.
